meta.title: A higher bid the buyer places on a vendor's behalf does not take the lead
gaps: The available vocabulary supports only vendor and vendor2; it cannot represent QA vendor 3.
The available read-back fields expose best-bidder status but not the L1 price, so unchanged L1 price is not checked.
The available tokens cannot express a price relative to QA vendor 1's existing bid; the surrogate price is set explicitly to 101.
warnings: verify 2: read_indicators's reply shape has not been sampled; "auction_identifiers_data.{{vendorUuid}}.inline.{{lineItemUuid}}.rank.best_bidder" is unverified
verify 2: read_indicators's reply shape has not been sampled; "auction_identifiers_data.{{vendor2Uuid}}.inline.{{lineItemUuid}}.rank.best_bidder" is unverified

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event where the invited QA vendor has submitted a bid; bidding still open.
steps: The buyer invites QA vendor 2 to the live round.
The buyer enters a surrogate bid of 101 on the vendor's behalf for a second QA vendor.
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that Data check: “bid count” equals 2.

As the buyer, read the round's comparison (ranks, best bidder) and check that Data check: “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 1 › inline › the line › rank › best bidder” equals true; Data check: “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 2 › inline › the line › rank › best bidder” equals false.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: Data check: “bid count” equals 2; Data check: “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 1 › inline › the line › rank › best bidder” equals true; Data check: “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 2 › inline › the line › rank › best bidder” equals false.
